Next-Gen Censorship-Resistant Blockchain Rewarding Creators: BlocTag Space

BlocTag (developed by LockTrace) is a self-sovereign Web3 social and financial ecosystem that eliminates centralized intermediaries, corporate surveillance, and censorship. Every thought is cryptographically sealed into the blockchain ledger, and creator royalties flow on-chain directly to author wallets for every like and comment.

ON-CHAIN SOCIAL PARADIGM

What is BlocTag?

BlocTag fundamentally rejects the centralized exploitation, private data harvesting, and shadow censorship of traditional social media. It is a pioneering protocol combining cryptographic immutability with creator-first economics.

gavel

Censorship-Resistant Content Ownership

Every thought you publish is permanently written to Proof-of-Work blocks as an on-chain transaction (space_post). No corporate executive, company, or server operator can delete your ideas, censor your feed, or ban your identity.

paid

Intermediary-Free Creator Royalties

Ad networks that monetize your data are eliminated. When someone likes your post, +0.002 BCT is instantly paid on-chain to your wallet, and thoughtful comments deliver +0.004 BCT in direct royalties.

fingerprint

Zero Personal Data & Self-Sovereignty

No phone numbers, emails, or KYC required. Your identity is purely your 12-word BIP-39 recovery phrase and SECP256k1 wallet address. Privacy and ownership are mathematically enforced.

TRANSPARENCY COMPARISON

Traditional Social Media vs BlocTag

Feature Traditional Networks (Web2) BlocTag (Web3)
Content Ownership Stored on corporate servers; deleted at company discretion. Owned by the creator; permanently sealed on-chain, immutable.
Monetization Model Ad corporations generate billions; zero revenue to creators. Every like and comment pays direct on-chain royalties to author.
User Privacy Phone, email, location, and tracking data sold to advertisers. Zero personal data! Authenticated solely by 12 cryptographic seed words.
Feed Algorithm Opaque black box engineered for addiction and behavioral manipulation. Chronological, open-source, and manipulation-free feed.
Server Reliance If the hosting company shuts down or blocks access, the platform dies. Global, immortal, and resilient thanks to the P2P node network.
TECHNOLOGY & PROTOCOL

Key Architectural Pillars of BlocTag (Developed by LockTrace)

memory 1. Tri-Tier 50/40/10 Hybrid Consensus

Block production uses CPU-friendly Proof-of-Work that anyone can run at home. 50% of each block reward goes to the PoW proposer, 40% is shared among active P2P validating nodes (Quorum), and 10% goes to passive Observer stakers.

shield 2. 100% Non-Custodial Security

Your BIP-39 recovery phrase and SECP256k1 private keys never leave your browser. All transactions and Space interactions are signed client-side via pure-JS & WebCrypto. Not even servers can see your keys.

verified_user 3. Tamper-Proof Frontend Shield

The web interface is protected with a SHA-256 checksum, official ECDSA release signature, and IPFS CIDv1. If malicious tampering is detected, nodes enforce an instant security lockout and refuse to serve modified files.

dns 4. Every Node Serves Its Own Web Wallet

node_runner.py serves both a full archival node and verified Web Wallet in a single command. Even if the main domain goes offline, you can access your wallet locally at http://127.0.0.1:5050.

account_tree Protocol Architecture & 1 Trillion Fixed Supply Tokenomics

LockTrace adopts a Hybrid PoW (Proof of Work) v2 + Active Quorum Peer-Validator consensus model rather than centralized validator cartels. The ledger state is managed via SQLite WAL with JSON block persistence.

1. Fixed Supply & Treasury Vault

The total maximum supply is mathematically capped at 1,000,000,000,000.00000000 BCT. New wallet welcome bonuses (1.00 BCT) and mining subsidies (0.05 BCT) are disbursed directly from the Genesis Treasury Vault (BCT_HAZINE_...). Future inflation or token minting is strictly impossible.

2. 1% Transfer Fee Distribution

A 1% network fee applies to all standard transfers. 50% returns to the Treasury Vault to preserve circulating supply scarcity, while the remaining 50% is distributed to the block proposer and active Quorum validators.

2B. 1.000 BCT PoS Validator Staking Vault

To eliminate Sybil attacks, consensus validators lock 1,000.00 BCT in BCT_STAKE_VAULT_... via 100% non-custodial ECDSA signatures. Staked validators share the 40% Quorum Attestation Pool (with 10% Observer Staking Pool for passive collateral) and face a 50% on-chain slash penalty for double-signing.

3. 50% / 40% / 10% Tri-Tier Block Reward

For each sealed block, 50% of the total reward pool goes to the PoW proposer who solved the cryptographic challenge, 40% is distributed among active P2P validating nodes (Quorum Pool), and 10% goes to Observer Stakers.

4. 10^8 Atomic Units (Zero Drift)

To prevent IEEE-754 floating point rounding drift at a 1-Trillion scale, all balance and fee computations are executed in 10^8 atomic integer units (1 BCT = 100,000,000 units).

LockTrace End-to-End System Blueprint

Comprehensive Architectural Map of the Layer-1 Blockchain Core & Web3 Frontend DApp

v2.11.0 Active 4-Tier Stack
Tier 1 • Client devices

Web3 Frontend & DApp

Browser-based single-page application executing non-custodial cryptography directly in client memory.

  • ▸Key Management: Pure WebCrypto SECP256k1 & BIP-39 (Zero key transmission)
  • ▸Secure Vault: AES-256-GCM local keystore with PIN salt derivation
  • ▸Navigation: 10 Router screens (Wallet, Space, Bridge, BNS, Explorer)
  • ▸Optimistic UX: Instant social reaction feedback with mempool auto-retry
  • ▸PWA Engine: Service Worker (sw.js) with immutable offline caching
Files: frontend/index.html, sw.js
Tier 2 • Mempool dns

Gateway & Hybrid Sequencer

High-throughput entry gate managing rate limits, cryptographic authentication, and time-and-quota transaction batching.

  • ▸REST API Gateway: Flask / Gunicorn + Multi-threaded Node Runner RPC
  • ▸Priority RBF: Dynamic mempool admission with lowest-fee eviction
  • ▸Compact Block Relay: Short 16-hex txids cut P2P block propagation by ~90%
  • ▸Hybrid Batching: Likes (20s/15-tx), Comments (50s/10-tx), General (20s/25-tx)
  • ▸Replay Protection: SlidingWindowRateLimiter + Full-history sig caching
Files: server.py, node_runner.py
Tier 3 • Consensus token

Layer-1 Core Engine

Deterministic cryptographic consensus layer orchestrating Proof-of-Work, atomic balances, and domain records.

  • ▸Consensus: 50% PoW Proposer + 40% Active Quorum Pool + 10% Observer Staking
  • ▸Anti-Stall LWMA: Emergency difficulty halving if block interval exceeds 120s
  • ▸State Snapshot Sync: Deterministic State Root warp sync (1,000-block window)
  • ▸Constant-Time Crypto: OpenSSL C SECP256k1 engine (Minerva mitigation)
  • ▸Storage Engine: SQLite WAL mode + atomic unit transactions (10^8 units)
Files: core/blockchain.py, core/storage.py
Tier 4 • Network polyline

Cross-Chain & P2P Fabric

Decentralized boundary bridges connecting native BCT to EVM Layer-2 and external community validator nodes.

  • ▸Base L2 Bridge: WrappedBlocTag ERC-20 contract (0xCa6152...EB28)
  • ▸Bridge Relayer: Automated dual-direction lock-and-burn listener daemon
  • ▸GPU Hardware Miner: OpenCL C kernel acceleration for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel
  • ▸Release Anchor: SECP256k1 signed frontend integrity (IPFS CIDv1 verified)
  • ▸Global Gossip: Multi-node block propagation with latency mitigation
Files: core/bridge_relayer.py, core/gpu_miner.py
sync_alt Data Flow: The Lifecycle of a Batched Web3 Transaction
STEP 1 • CLIENT SIGN User signs payload via Pure WebCrypto ECDSA in browser. Zero secret keys touch network.
STEP 2 • INGESTION Gateway validates signature, nonce, and rate limit. Prevents replay attacks.
STEP 3 • MEMPOOL BATCH Tx enters mempool with optimistic UI update. Evaluates 20s/50s window & quota.
STEP 4 • POW SEALING Sequencer/Miner packages batch into PoW Block. Calculates SHA-256 Merkle root.
STEP 5 • SETTLEMENT Block committed to SQLite WAL and gossiped to P2P peers. 50% Miner / 40% Validator / 10% Observer.

forum BlocTag On-Chain Social & Royalty Protocol

BlocTag embeds social interactions directly into the blockchain transaction ledger. Posts, likes, and comments function as autonomous economic operations on-chain.

A) PUBLISH POST (space_post) Fee: 0.10 BCT

The author pays 0.10 BCT to seal the post into the blockchain (80% returns to the Treasury Pool, 20% rewards active PoW miners and validators).

Canonical Signature: {author_address}:{content}
B) LIKE ROYALTY (space_like) Cost: 0.01 BCT (+0.002 BCT to Author)

Liking a post costs 0.01 BCT. Of this, +0.002 BCT (20%) is instantly paid on-chain to the author's wallet; 0.007 BCT (70%) returns to Treasury and 0.001 BCT (10%) rewards validators.

Canonical Signature: {liker_address}:{post_id}
C) COMMENT ROYALTY (space_comment) Cost: 0.02 BCT (+0.004 BCT to Author)

Posting an on-chain comment creates a 0.02 BCT transaction. +0.004 BCT (20%) is transferred to the original author's wallet; 0.014 BCT (70%) returns to Treasury and 0.002 BCT (10%) rewards validators.

Canonical Signature: {commenter_address}:{post_id}:{content}
D) FOLLOW CREATOR (space_follow) Cost: 1.00 BCT (+0.50 BCT to Creator)

Following a creator on-chain costs 1.00 BCT. Of this, +0.50 BCT (50%) is deposited directly to the target creator; 0.40 BCT (40%) locks in Treasury, and 0.10 BCT (10%) rewards validators.

Canonical Signature: {follower_address}:{target_address}

terminal Independent P2P Node & Web Server Deployment

download Download node_runner.py

node_runner.py runs a standalone archival node and Web Wallet with zero external package dependencies (pure Python standard library) across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

A) LOCAL MODE (YOUR COMPUTER ONLY)
python node_runner.py --local --open Verifies SHA-256 integrity, launches the local web wallet at http://127.0.0.1:5050, and opens your browser automatically.
B) SERVER / LAN MODE (PUBLIC WEB & RPC)
python node_runner.py --server --port 5050 Serves both the Web Wallet and decentralized RPC endpoints to all network devices or public web at http://SERVER_IP:5050.
C) LINK YOUR WEB WALLET TO NODE
python node_runner.py --wallet BCTyourwalletaddress... Directs all earned PoW proposer rewards (70%) and Quorum validator distributions (30%) straight into your web wallet address.
D) GPU HARDWARE MINING (OPENCL)
python node_runner.py --server --gpu --wallet BCTyourwalletaddress... Activates hardware-accelerated OpenCL C kernel mining across NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel GPUs for massively accelerated PoW hashrates.
E) STATE SNAPSHOT WARP SYNC (FAST NODE SETUP)
python node_runner.py --local --sync-mode snapshot --open Instantly downloads verified State Snapshot (deterministic state root) and cryptographically replays only recent 1,000 blocks to tip in seconds.
info How to Spend Earned Rewards (No Claiming Required)

Rewards are not locked in smart contracts; they are recorded as direct on-chain transactions to your wallet address. If you launch the node without specifying a wallet, the system automatically creates ~/.locktrace/miner_wallet.json. You can copy the 64-character Private Key from that file and paste it into the Create / Import tab on the web app to access and transfer your full balance.

enhanced_encryption Cryptographic Security & Signed Release Integrity

LockTrace mathematically guarantees user asset sovereignty and source code integrity through cryptographic proofs.

1. SECP256k1 & Deterministic Low-S

Employs the same battle-tested elliptic curve as Bitcoin and Ethereum. RFC 6979 deterministic HMAC-SHA256 k-generation and mandatory canonical Low-S signatures prevent signature malleability attacks.

2. Binary Merkle Tree & SPV Proofs

Transactions in every block are structured into a binary SHA-256 Merkle tree. Light clients (web browsers) mathematically verify transaction inclusion using O(log N) Merkle audit paths without downloading the full chain.

3. AES-256-GCM PIN Vault

When encrypting your wallet with a PIN, private keys are protected client-side via WebCrypto PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations), random 16-byte salt, and 12-byte IV using AES-256-GCM. Unencrypted keys are never saved to disk.

4. SHA-256 Release Seal & IPFS CID

The official web interface SHA-256 digest and IPFS CIDv1 address are signed by the Release Authority public key and sealed on-chain. If any client file is tampered with, the node enforces an immediate lockout.

5. Anti-Stall Emergency LWMA Failsafe

If network block intervals exceed 120s (6x target block time due to sudden miner drop-offs), the consensus engine dynamically halves difficulty, preventing chain stalls with zero central coordinator.

6. Priority RBF & Mempool Eviction

When the global mempool hits its 5,000 transaction ceiling, lower-fee transactions are evicted in favor of higher-paying transfers, rendering spam floods economically futile.

7. P2P Compact Block Relay (BIP-152)

Blocks are gossiped using lightweight headers and 16-hex short transaction IDs. Nodes reconstruct blocks from local mempools with ~90-95% lower network bandwidth consumption.

8. State Snapshot Warp Sync

New nodes can download a deterministically hashed State Root over sorted accounts and BNS handles, verifying only the past 1,000 blocks to tip for instantaneous sync without trust compromises.

help Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How is BlocTag different from other blockchains (Ethereum, Solana, etc.)? expand_more

Ethereum and Solana are general-purpose smart contract networks where frequent social interactions are prohibitively expensive. BlocTag integrates social dynamics (posts, likes, comments, royalties, and creator ownership) directly into the Layer 1 core blockchain. It offers zero smart contract vulnerability risk, deterministic zero-gas fees, and immediate micro-payments to creator wallets.

What happens to my wallet if the main website (locktrace.space) shuts down or creators leave? expand_more

Your funds and posts remain completely safe. LockTrace is 100% non-custodial; your private keys reside solely in your 12 recovery words. Even if the main web domain vanishes, you can run python node_runner.py --local --open on your own machine to view your balance, sign transactions locally, and sync with independent P2P nodes.

Do I need specialized mining rigs (ASICs) or expensive servers to run a node? expand_more

No! LockTrace consensus is specifically engineered to be CPU-friendly. A standard laptop, home desktop, or entry-level cloud VPS (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM) runs effortlessly with zero extra package dependencies. You earn 50% PoW block rewards, 40% Quorum validator distributions, and 10% Observer staking rewards.

If I lose my 12-Word Recovery Phrase, can support or admins recover my account? expand_more

No. LockTrace is a genuine decentralized blockchain. No administrator, support team, or developer has access to your private key. You must physically write down your 12 words and store them in a secure location.

shield_lock Protocol Security & Risk Framework

BlocTag Security Policy & Protocol Disclosure (Developed by LockTrace)

Self-sovereign Web3 architecture, strict non-custodial key ownership, smart contract reserve verification, and responsible vulnerability disclosure framework.

verified_user

Cryptographic Integrity Shield (v2.11.0)

ACTIVE • VERIFIED

All frontend client code is cryptographically sealed via SHA-256 checksums and ECDSA Release Authority signatures.

key

1. Non-Custodial Architecture & Sovereign Key Custody

BIP-39 Mnemonic • PBKDF2 HMAC-SHA512 • SECP256k1 ECDSA

All wallets generated on LockTrace operate under strict 100% non-custodial principles. Your 12-word recovery mnemonic seed phrase and private keys are generated and stored exclusively inside your local device browser sandbox (localStorage / Web Crypto API).

  • Zero Server Custody: LockTrace servers, peer nodes, and developers never have access to, receive, or store your private keys or seed phrase.
  • Irreversible Sovereignty: There is no centralized password recovery, email reset, or custodial account freezing. Full responsibility for seed phrase backup rests exclusively with the account holder.
  • Client-Side Signing: Every transaction is cryptographically signed locally on the client device before transmission. Nodes receive only the finalized, signed raw transaction bytes.
swap_horiz

2. Smart Contract & Cross-Chain Bridge Security

Wrapped BCT (wBCT) • Base Mainnet ERC-20 • 1:1 Proof-of-Reserve

Asset bridging between the BlocTag Layer-1 ledger and Ethereum L2 (Base Mainnet) is secured through a 1:1 fully collateralized lock-and-mint architecture:

wBCT Contract (Base): 0xCa6152Ae0E785F90ED65cd706B386E5B83D0EB28
L1 Collateral Vault: BCT_BRIDGE_VAULT_0000000000000000000000000000000
  • 1:1 Proof-of-Reserve: Every 1 wBCT minted on Base is backed by exactly 1 native BCT escrowed in the Layer-1 bridge vault. Unbacked minting or arbitrary token inflation is mathematically impossible.
  • Two-Way Settlement (Burn & Unlock): When users burn wBCT on Base, decentralized bridge oracles verify finality and release the equivalent native BCT from the Layer-1 vault.
  • DEX Liquidity Assurance: Decentralized exchange liquidity pools on Uniswap ensure continuous, trustless market depth and transparent trading pairs.
memory

3. Hybrid Consensus, LWMA Dynamic Difficulty & Finality

LWMA-20 Target • Post-Block Finality Quorum • 1,000 BCT Stake • 1% Fee Split

The BlocTag Layer-1 network combines cryptographic Proof-of-Work (PoW) with asynchronous Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) post-block finality checkpoints:

  • LWMA Dynamic Difficulty & Anti-Stall Failsafe: A Linear Weighted Moving Average over the past 20 blocks adaptively tunes mining difficulty to maintain a predictable 20.0-second block time. An emergency failsafe automatically halves difficulty if block times exceed 120s (6x target).
  • Post-Block Finality Checkpoint (Option A): Miners propose blocks immediately upon finding a valid nonce; blocks achieve irreversible settlement when signed by a ≥ 2/3 validator quorum attestation.
  • Sybil Defense & Validator Stake: Nodes must stake at least 1,000 BCT to join the active validator committee. Malicious double-signing (equivocation) results in immediate stake slashing and peer eviction.
  • Priority RBF & Mempool Eviction: Saturated mempools (5,000 tx ceiling) dynamically evict lowest-fee transfers to accommodate higher-fee incoming transactions.
  • P2P Compact Block Relay & State Snapshot Sync: BIP-152 short txid block relay slashes bandwidth by ~90-95%, while deterministic state root snapshots allow warp syncing nodes with rolling 1,000-block verification.
  • Anti-Spam Action Cooldowns: Built-in protocol rate limiting enforces per-wallet cooldowns (Transfer: 3s, Post: 10s, Like: 0s Instant, Comment: 5s, Follow: 3s, BNS: 10s) alongside mempool double-spend balances.
  • 1% Protocol Fee Split & Deflation: Out of the automated 1% transaction fee, 50% is permanently locked into the Treasury Vault (deflationary supply reduction), 35% goes to the block proposer, and 15% rewards the validator quorum.
gavel

4. Cryptographic Frontend Seal & Anti-Phishing Defense

On-Chain Code Sealing • SHA-256 • ECDSA Release Authority

A critical vulnerability of Web3 dApps is DNS hijacking, CDN injection, or unauthorized code tampering (XSS / supply-chain attacks). LockTrace addresses this at the blockchain consensus layer:

  • On-Chain Code Sealing: Every frontend release (index.html and sw.js) is hashed via SHA-256, cryptographically signed by the official Release Authority (BCT885bc...), and anchored permanently on-chain in a release block.
  • Node-Level Security Lockout: All network nodes independently verify the SHA-256 checksum and ECDSA signature prior to serving the web interface. If a single byte is altered, an automatic HTTP 403 Security Lockout is triggered, safeguarding user funds.
bug_report

5. Responsible Disclosure & Vulnerability Program

locktracetoken+space@gmail.com • Bug Bounty • White-Hat Researchers

LockTrace actively collaborates with independent security researchers, ethical hackers, and external auditors to maintain the highest security standards:

  • Reporting Channel: Please report any identified vulnerabilities directly to locktracetoken+space@gmail.com or confidentially via GitHub Security Advisories.
  • Coordinated Disclosure: We ask researchers to allow a minimum of 48 hours for core developers to review, patch, and deploy fixes across validator nodes before any public disclosure.
  • Bug Bounty Rewards: Valid, verified security vulnerabilities are eligible for BCT protocol bounty rewards commensurate with severity.
warning

6. User Safety Guidelines & Risk Disclosure

Essential User Precautions & Legal Notice

To protect your decentralized assets, please adhere strictly to these fundamental security rules:

• Never Share Your 12-Word Seed Phrase: No LockTrace administrator, developer, or bot will ever ask for your mnemonic phrase or private key.
• Avoid Digital Screenshots: Screenshots stored in unencrypted cloud sync services can be compromised by third-party malware. Always record your seed phrase offline on physical media.
• Verify Official URLs: Always ensure you are accessing https://locktrace.space or https://www.locktrace.space with a valid TLS certificate.
• Market & Liquidity Risks: Digital assets are subject to market volatility. Cross-chain bridging and decentralized exchange liquidity operations may involve slippage and network gas fees.
